status: Conditional gross-value-added contribution scenario, not causal or observed GDP growth

sources.title: OECD GDP and non-financial accounts
sources.reference: GDP output and expenditure definitions; accessed 10 October 2026
sources.caveat: Supports the accounting definition only, not the assumed time use, productivity or spending rates.

sources.title: Eurostat annual national accounts metadata
sources.reference: ESA 2010 GDP and gross value added definitions; accessed 10 October 2026
sources.caveat: Gross value added excludes net taxes on products. This app does not estimate those taxes or a full regional GDP account.

formulas.H: signed pedestrian hours saved + signed vehicle hours saved x occupancy
formulas.work: H x work_time_fraction x productivity_realization x labour_value_eur_h
formulas.spending: H x spending_time_fraction x spending_eur_h x spending_additionality x domestic_value_added_fraction
formulas.gdp_scenario_eur: work + non-overlapping spending-induced domestic value added

work_time_fraction.notes: Share of signed net time changes allocated to work. Work and spending allocations together cannot exceed 100%.

productivity_realization.notes: Share of work-allocated time that actually changes productive output, not merely commute convenience.

labour_value_eur_h.status: illustrative assumption, not a Turin statistic
labour_value_eur_h.notes: Incremental domestic value added per realized productive hour, not employee wage, business revenue or willingness to pay.

spending_time_fraction.notes: Disjoint share allocated to spending opportunities; remaining time receives no GDP contribution.

spending_eur_h.status: illustrative assumption, not a Turin statistic
spending_eur_h.notes: Potential spending per hour allocated to consumption; not automatically additional expenditure.

spending_additionality.notes: Only net-new expenditure, after removing shifted purchases, budget substitution and output already counted in the work channel. Zero until an explicit scenario or evidence supports a nonzero share.

domestic_value_added_fraction.status: illustrative assumption, not an input-output coefficient
domestic_value_added_fraction.notes: Domestic value added per euro of net-new spending. Excludes imports and intermediate inputs; not a retailer margin or a fiscal multiplier. Domestic is not necessarily within Turin.

limitations: Time savings are isolated-crossing sums, not calibrated whole-journey time gains or unique people.
Net losses of time produce negative contributions under the same allocation assumptions; no positive-only selection is used.

A joint production-demand or input-output model is needed to identify independent work and consumption effects. Additivity is an explicit no-overlap scenario assumption, not proven by time allocation alone.
Results exclude net product taxes, economic multipliers, opportunity costs of public funds, induced demand and deployment-sector output; no percentage increase in Turin GDP is inferred.
The proxy is not added to social NPV or time-value benefits, nor treated as municipal revenue. The legacy gdp_increase_eur field remains null because causal GDP change is unidentified.
